title: Unit orientations under linear pull-back: the Hadamard bound and the fixed-plane identity
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Q ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace, ξ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q: ξ(α) = ±α(τ₁, …, τₙ) for all n-covectors α, for an orthonormal family τ spanning Q), and L : ℝ^P → ℝ^P a continuous linear map. Then: (a) |ξ(α∘L)| ≤ |α|_E·‖L‖ⁿ for every n-covector α, where α∘L := α.compContinuousLinearMap L, |α|_E := covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm (Simon 6.1.15) and ‖L‖ is the operator norm; (b) if Lv = v for every v ∈ Q, then ξ(α∘L) = ξ(α) for every n-covector α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ (α.compContinuousLinearMap L)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α * ‖L‖ ^ n) ∧ ((∀ v ∈ Q, L v = v) → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ (α.compContinuousLinearMap L) = ξ α)
